name: Goulg
source:
A member of a clan of extreme masochists, Goulg and her kind wrap themselves in bandages as it facilitates bondage play, exhibitionist play and conveniently hides any injuries sustained during whipping play and other potentially skin-marking sex plays. When they first lay eyes on Primtine's castle, they imagine the perfect extreme sadist master resides in it and attack the castle in hopes of being enslaved under this perfect master.

[Spoiler] Fabio is initially unsure what to make of the masochistic pervert, eventually he uses his innate talents to win Goulg over. Castle residents who mock Goulg for her perverse habits are eventually left trembling with fear as Goulg attempts to "convince" them of the merits of masochistic sex play.

Fabio is eventually forced to use reverse psychology to convince Goulg to fight the enemy properly during battles instead of treating them as a chance for receiving punishment as a consequence for failure.

In her end, she is almost forced to return to her clan home for a vacation. Although extremely unwilling to leave the source of her masochistic pleasures, she eventually convinces herself it's another form of sadistic torture and enjoys its duration while pining for a quick return to the castle. [/Spoiler]
